body:
Track 4 follow-up to `robofab-solreftimestep` (its first "next step"): runs the cover-part jaw test over 4 solref x 4 timestep x 2 accelerations with MuJoCo's `refsafe` flag on and off. Stylised, simulation only; results are in `experiments/results.txt`.

Key results: 11/32 cells hold with refsafe on, 10/32 off, 7 cells differ; 10 runs go unstable with it off; the non-monotone timestep behaviour survives, so refsafe does not explain it.

Checks: 8 unit tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
